artDirection.subject: 团结乡紧凑内向院落建筑群

高实墙、石基和坡地入口关系

mustAvoid: converting scan fragments into unsupported BIM semantics
treating normalized display bounds as measured dimensions
borrowing exact tile, stair or timber dimensions from another case

runtime.originRule: XY bounding-box center at minimum Z

performanceBudget.mobilePolicy: Do not load automatically; require explicit click. Produce a separate decimated LOD before default mobile use.

allowed: layered observation of base, first floor, second floor, roof and details

notAllowed: treat scan mesh as editable BIM semantics
auto-fit procedural walls, roofs or bays from the scan without evidence
claim exact door, window, column, beam or stair dimensions from the current scan alone
replace the existing canonical Yunnan procedural cases
nextActions: lock a measured plan and section against the scan before assigning bay and floor IDs

compare C2 proportions with the existing three-bay front-gallery and Yikeyin cases
keep unresolved roof, opening and joinery claims pending until close-up evidence is available

visual: The complete enclosure and courtyard void remain visible in the reference view.
Roof, wall, stone-base and terrain relationships do not show new gaps or intersections introduced by conversion.
The editable master retains the High source composition and material assignment.
technical: The editable master parses as glTF 2.0 GLB with no container error.
The editable master stays below 500000 triangles and the high-profile 120 MB ceiling.
Runtime metadata labels the bounds as display-only and the physical scale as unverified.
The production webpage loads the derived GLB only after an explicit click; the private source files remain excluded.
semantic: No scan fragment is asserted as a verified architectural component.
Locality is user-confirmed; all precise measurements and construction claims remain evidence-gated.
